# 0.11.1 — messages workspace, auto-reconnect, security

A focused follow-up to 0.11.0: a rebuilt Messages workspace, safer boot-time
reconnect behaviour, dashboard identity resolution, and a clean dependency/CI
baseline. **No breaking API or data changes.**

## Manager

- **Messages data layer** — chats, thread history, contacts, sender names and
  server flags now use TanStack Query. History uses infinite pagination; sends
  are optimistic with rollback; WebSocket events invalidate the right caches,
  and polling takes over when real time is unavailable.
- **Thread rendering** — day separators, quoted-message previews, sender grouping,
  linkified text, unsupported-message placeholders, and a floating
  “jump to latest” action.
- **New conversation dialog** — searchable contacts/groups, recent conversations
  and phone-number entry. Recover-history moved into the thread header.
- **Media experience** — image/video lightbox with previous/next and download,
  document cards, upload progress, drag-and-drop and clipboard paste.
- **Mobile** — icon-first responsive header, bottom-sheet new-chat dialog,
  safe-area composer and better thread navigation.
- **Instance cards** — the interactive-message tester moved to the Messages
  header, so connected cards have four clear actions and delete is no longer
  crowded out.

## API / reliability

- **Boot-time reconnect** — paired instances reconnect after a restart by
  default. A new `auto_reconnect` intent is persisted: connect/reconnect set it,
  while an explicit API disconnect or logout clears it, so those instances stay
  down (migration 0007).
- **Dashboard conversation identities** — top sources resolve LIDs to phone
  numbers and saved contact names from the shared stores, even when the owning
  instance is offline. This also fixes a nil contact-store panic in
  `/server/stats`.

## Security / CI

- `golang.org/x/net` 0.62.0 and the patched `golang.org/x/crypto`.
- Manager `axios`, `zod`, `vite` and transitive security overrides refreshed.
- `govulncheck ./...` and `bun audit` are clean.
- Workflows pinned to `ubuntu-24.04`; `setup-go` upgraded to v7 and
  `gitleaks-action` to v3 (both Node 24).
- Fixed the race-job temp-directory flake caused by async test loggers.

## Container image

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/felipeestevanatto/wamux:0.11.1
docker pull ghcr.io/felipeestevanatto/wamux:latest
```
